name: waterdata-usgs
description: USGS Water Data for the Nation: find stream, lake and groundwater monitoring locations and fetch their real-time readings, field measurements, time-series metadata, daily statistics, basins and flowlines using the public USGS Water Data APIs.

commands.name: search-monitoring-locations
commands.summary: Full-text search for monitoring locations by water body, place name or ID (e.g. 'Potomac River').

params.name: q
params.description: Free-text query: water body, city, location name or number

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Maximum number of results (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

commands.name: find-monitoring-locations-by-number
commands.summary: Look up monitoring locations whose site number contains a partial number (e.g. '0164600'). This is the site's number autocomplete.

params.name: number
params.description: Full or partial USGS site number without the 'USGS-' prefix

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Maximum number of results (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

commands.verifyNote: write: dry-run preview only, not sent

commands.name: get-monitoring-location
commands.summary: Get summary metadata for one monitoring location: name, coordinates, elevation, drainage area and description.

params.name: id
params.description: Monitoring location ID with agency prefix, e.g. USGS-01646500

commands.name: list-monitoring-locations-in-bbox
commands.summary: List monitoring locations inside a bounding box (the Explore map). Filter by data type, site type, parameter code and recent activity.

params.name: boundingBox
params.description: minLon,minLat,maxLon,maxLat in WGS84 degrees

params.name: dataType
params.description: Only locations that record this data collection category

params.name: siteTypeCode
params.description: Site type code, e.g. ST (stream), LK (lake), ES (estuary), OC (ocean), GW (well)

params.name: usgsPCode
params.description: USGS parameter code observed at the location, e.g. 00060 (discharge) or 00065 (gage height)

params.name: dataCollectedSinceDatetime
params.description: Only locations with data collected since this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Maximum number of locations returned

commands.name: list-time-series
commands.summary: List the time series at a monitoring location: series ID, parameter, period of record and description. Needed for the data and statistics commands.

params.name: monitoring_location_id
params.description: Monitoring location ID, e.g. USGS-01646500

params.name: statistic_id
params.description: Statistic code: 00003 = daily mean, 00011 = instantaneous (continuous)

params.name: parameter_code
params.description: Parameter code, e.g. 00060 (discharge, ft^3/s) or 00065 (gage height, ft)

commands.name: get-continuous-data
commands.summary: Get continuous (instantaneous, ~15-minute) readings for a time series or for a location and parameter over a recent period.

params.name: time_series_id
params.description: Time series ID from list-time-series (statistic 00011)

params.name: monitoring_location_id
params.description: Alternative to time_series_id: monitoring location ID, e.g. USGS-01646500

params.name: parameter_code
params.description: Parameter code to use with monitoring_location_id, e.g. 00060 or 00065

params.name: time
params.description: ISO 8601 duration back from now (P7D, P30D) or an interval start/end

commands.name: get-field-measurements
commands.summary: Get manual field measurements (e.g. measured discharge or gage height) at a monitoring location.

params.name: monitoring_location_id
params.description: Monitoring location ID, e.g. USGS-01646500

params.name: parameter_code
params.description: Parameter code, e.g. 00060 (discharge) or 00065 (gage height)

params.name: time
params.description: ISO 8601 interval start/end, e.g. 2026-09-18T00:00:00Z/2026-10-18T00:00:00Z, or a duration like P1Y

commands.name: get-daily-normals
commands.summary: Get day-of-year statistics (median, mean, percentiles) for a daily time series, optionally for a calendar-day range.

params.name: parent_time_series_id
params.description: Daily time series ID from list-time-series (statistic_id 00003)

params.name: start_date
params.description: Calendar day MM-DD, e.g. 10-18

params.name: end_date
params.description: Calendar day MM-DD, e.g. 10-18

params.name: computation_type
params.description: Statistic to compute

params.name: approval_status
params.description: Restrict to approved data

commands.name: get-observation-intervals
commands.summary: Get monthly and yearly aggregate statistics (e.g. arithmetic mean per month) for daily time series.

params.name: parent_time_series_id
params.description: Daily time series ID from list-time-series (statistic_id 00003)

params.name: computation_type
params.description: Statistic to compute

params.name: approval_status
params.description: Restrict to approved data

commands.name: search-parameter-codes
commands.summary: Find USGS parameter codes whose description contains a keyword, case-insensitive (e.g. 'discharge' → 00060).

params.name: keyword
params.description: Word to look for in the parameter description

commands.name: get-states
commands.summary: Look up US states/territories by FIPS-based ID (e.g. US-24 → MD), or list them all.

params.name: id
params.description: State ID as US-<2-digit FIPS>, e.g. US-24

commands.name: get-hydrologic-unit
commands.summary: Get the name of a hydrologic unit (HUC watershed) from its code.

params.name: huc
params.description: Hydrologic unit code (2-12 digits), e.g. 020700081005

commands.name: get-flood-stage
commands.summary: Get NWS flood-stage thresholds (action/minor/moderate/major) for a site; returns {} when none are defined.

params.name: site_number
params.description: USGS site number without the 'USGS-' prefix, e.g. 01646500

commands.name: get-basin
commands.summary: Get the upstream drainage basin polygon (GeoJSON) for a monitoring location from the NLDI.

params.name: id
params.description: Monitoring location ID, e.g. USGS-01646500

commands.name: navigate-flowlines
commands.summary: Get the NHDPlus river flowlines upstream (UM) or downstream (DM) along the main stem from a monitoring location.

params.name: id
params.description: Monitoring location ID, e.g. USGS-01646500

params.name: mode
params.description: UM = upstream main stem, DM = downstream main stem

params.name: distance
params.description: Navigation distance in kilometers

commands.name: list-states
commands.summary: List the states and territories of a country, with their browse URLs (the state codes are FIPS).

params.name: country
params.description: Country code

commands.name: list-counties
commands.summary: List the counties in a state, with their browse URLs (the county codes are FIPS).

params.name: state_code
params.description: 2-digit state FIPS code, e.g. 24 for Maryland

commands.name: list-county-monitoring-locations
commands.summary: List every monitoring location in a county, by name and ID.

params.name: state_code
params.description: 2-digit state FIPS code, e.g. 24

params.name: county_code
params.description: 3-digit county FIPS code, e.g. 031 (Montgomery County, MD)

notes: Monitoring location IDs carry the agency prefix (USGS-01646500). get-flood-stage and find-monitoring-locations-by-number take the bare site number.

Typical workflow: search-monitoring-locations or list-monitoring-locations-in-bbox → list-time-series (monitoring_location_id) → get-continuous-data (time_series_id with statistic 00011) or get-daily-normals / get-observation-intervals (parent_time_series_id with statistic 00003).
Common parameter codes: 00060 = discharge (ft^3/s), 00065 = gage height (ft), 00010 = water temperature (°C). Use search-parameter-codes to find others.
Discontinued time series return empty feature lists for recent periods. Check begin_utc/end_utc and web_description in list-time-series first.
The api.waterdata.usgs.gov endpoints work without an API key but are rate-limited. The web app sends an x-api-key header, which is omitted here.
get-continuous-data accepts either time_series_id, or monitoring_location_id plus parameter_code. Give at least one of these.
find-monitoring-locations-by-number is a read-only CQL2 JSON search sent as a POST; it does not modify data.
Browse-command URLs are site-relative; prefix them with https://waterdata.usgs.gov.
